panels.description: Porcentaje del contexto reutilizado desde cache: cacheRead / (input + cacheRead).

targets.expr: 100 * sum(increase(opencode_token_usage_tokens_total{team_name=~"$team_name", user_name=~"$user_name", agent=~"$agent", model=~"$model", provider=~"$provider", type="cacheRead", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum(increase(opencode_token_usage_tokens_total{team_name=~"$team_name", user_name=~"$user_name", agent=~"$agent", model=~"$model", provider=~"$provider", type=~"input|cacheRead", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.title: Cache hit ratio

targets.expr: 100 * sum(increase(opencode_token_usage_tokens_total{team_name=~"$team_name", user_name=~"$user_name", agent=~"$agent", model=~"$model", provider=~"$provider", type="output", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum(increase(opencode_token_usage_tokens_total{team_name=~"$team_name", user_name=~"$user_name", agent=~"$agent", model=~"$model", provider=~"$provider", type=~"input|output", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.title: Output ratio

panels.description: Respuestas completas por sesion en el rango seleccionado.

targets.expr: sum(increase(opencode_request_count_total{team_name=~"$team_name", user_name=~"$user_name", agent=~"$agent", model=~"$model", provider=~"$provider", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(count(count by (session_id) (count_over_time(opencode_request_count_total{team_name=~"$team_name", user_name=~"$user_name", agent=~"$agent", model=~"$model", provider=~"$provider", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range]))), 1)

panels.title: Interactions per session

targets.expr: count(count by (model) (increase(opencode_token_usage_tokens_total{team_name=~"$team_name", user_name=~"$user_name", agent=~"$agent", model=~"$model", provider=~"$provider", type=~"$token_type", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range]) > 0))

panels.title: Models used

panels.description: Tokens contabilizados en el rango seleccionado.

targets.expr: sum(increase(opencode_token_usage_tokens_total{team_name=~"$team_name", user_name=~"$user_name", agent=~"$agent", model=~"$model", provider=~"$provider", type=~"$token_type", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Total tokens

panels.description: Participacion por modelo en el consumo total de tokens.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (increase(opencode_token_usage_tokens_total{team_name=~"$team_name", user_name=~"$user_name", agent=~"$agent", model=~"$model", provider=~"$provider", type=~"$token_type", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range]))
